title: Ulysses: A Security Harness For Synthesizing Verifiable Web Exploits
title_zh: Ulysses：用于合成可验证 Web 漏洞利用的安全测试装置

paragraphs.en: How can an AI agent automatically discover security vulnerabilities in any software repository? Existing approaches use LLMs to generate software vulnerability exploits. However, it is challenging for an LLM to reliably verify its own generated exploits. In this paper, we propose Ulysses , a multi-agent security harness to synthesize verifiable vulnerability exploits for web applications. Ulysses converts candidate vulnerability findings into verified Proofs of Exploitability by iteratively exploring exploit hypotheses and establishing success in independently observed execution effects. We evaluated Ulysses on WebExploitGym , a curated benchmark of exploitable instances from 25 real-world web applications that span 5 languages and 7 frameworks. Ulysses produces verified proofs for 10 of 25 real-world advisories. It also discovered 4 new proofs of exploitability that have never been previously reported.
paragraphs.zh: AI 智能体如何能在任意软件仓库中自动发现安全漏洞？ 现有方法使用大语言模型来生成软件漏洞利用。 然而，让大语言模型可靠地验证其自身生成的漏洞利用是一项挑战。 在本文中，我们提出了 Ulysses，一个用于为 Web 应用合成可验证漏洞利用的多智能体安全测试框架。 Ulysses 通过迭代探索漏洞利用假设并在独立观测的执行效果中确立成功，将候选漏洞发现转化为已验证的可利用性证明。 我们在 WebExploitGym 上评估了 Ulysses，这是一个精选的基准，包含来自 25 个真实 Web 应用的可利用实例，涵盖 5 种语言和 7 个框架。 Ulysses 为 25 个真实安全公告中的 10 个生成了已验证的证明。 它还发现了 4 个此前从未被报告过的全新可利用性证明。

paragraphs.en: Security analysis often begins with finding vulnerabilities using static analysis tools, code reviews, or automated security review tools. However, a finding is ultimately a hypothesis as to whether a code path is vulnerable. The strongest evidence for a vulnerability is a Proof of Exploitability (PoE) [ 32 ] . It demonstrates an attacker’s capability against a deployed system. However, converting a finding into a verified exploit is difficult [ 38 ] . It requires understanding the complete attack path, application state, input transformations, authentication requirements, and the construction of a payload that successfully triggers the vulnerability.
paragraphs.zh: 安全分析通常始于使用静态分析工具、代码审查或自动化安全审查工具来发现漏洞。 然而，一个发现本质上只是一个关于某条代码路径是否存在漏洞的假设。 漏洞最有力的证据是可利用性证明（PoE）[ 32 ]。 它证明了攻击者针对已部署系统的攻击能力。 然而，将一个发现转化为经过验证的漏洞利用十分困难 [ 38 ]。 这需要理解完整的攻击路径、应用状态、输入变换、身份验证要求，以及构造能够成功触发漏洞的载荷。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used for vulnerability detection because they can reason about source code and application logic and identify vulnerability patterns that are difficult to capture with traditional rule-based analysis [ 22 , 35 ] . The LLM-generated findings should still be treated as potential vulnerabilities and need actual confirmation before being triaged. The report does not establish that an attacker can successfully exploit the reported flaw. LLM Agents are automated and easier for developers to run, generating candidate findings at scale. This amplifies the existing triage burden by producing large volumes of potential but unverified findings.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于漏洞检测，因为它们能够对源代码和应用逻辑进行推理，并识别传统基于规则的分析难以捕捉的漏洞模式 [ 22 , 35 ] 。 LLM 生成的结果仍应被视为潜在漏洞，需要在分类处理前进行实际确认。 该报告并不能证明攻击者能够成功利用所报告的缺陷。 LLM 智能体是自动化的，开发人员更容易运行，能够大规模生成候选结果。 这通过产生大量潜在但未经验证的结果，加剧了现有的分类处理负担。

paragraphs.en: Recent experience with real-world security reporting illustrates this problem. Curl, one of the most widely used libraries for transferring files, reported that its public bug bounty program [ 6 ] had about 20% of vulnerabilities incorrectly generated by AI. These findings were overwhelmingly low quality, eventually leading to the shutdown of the program [ 7 ] . Although AI-generated reports were fluent and plausible, they lacked executable findings or proof that the flaw was real [ 5 ] . In May 2026, GitHub revised its bug bounty program to reduce the volume of low-effort and AI-generated reports [ 15 ] . It suggests that developers focus on quality and provide proofs-of-concept that demonstrate real security or threat [ 16 ] . Improving language models to generate vulnerability reports does not necessarily improve the ability to verify vulnerabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 近期现实世界安全报告的经验说明了这个问题。 Curl 是最广泛使用的文件传输库之一，其报告指出，其公开的漏洞赏金计划 [ 6 ] 中约 20% 的漏洞是由 AI 错误生成的。 这些结果绝大多数质量低下，最终导致该计划被关闭 [ 7 ] 。 尽管 AI 生成的报告语言流畅且貌似合理，但它们缺乏可执行的发现或证明缺陷真实存在的证据 [ 5 ] 。 2026 年 5 月，GitHub 修订了其漏洞赏金计划，以减少低投入和 AI 生成的报告数量 [ 15 ] 。 它建议开发者专注于质量，并提供能够证明真实安全或威胁的概念验证 [ 16 ] 。 改进语言模型以生成漏洞报告，并不一定能提升验证漏洞的能力。

paragraphs.en: The problem is not limited to curl. Many real-world advisories on real-world repositories lack a complete proof of concept to trace, which makes a reported flaw hard to reproduce or debug. In May 2026 alone, the GitHub Advisory Database published 1,560 reviewed advisories, the highest in its history [ 14 ] . Sampling these advisories, we estimate that roughly half lacked Proof of Exploit. A developer reading such an advisory can see that a flaw was reported but not whether it can be exploited in their deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题并不仅限于 curl。 现实世界仓库上的许多真实安全公告缺少可追踪的完整概念验证，这使得被报告的缺陷难以复现或调试。 仅在 2026 年 5 月，GitHub 公告数据库就发布了 1,560 条经审核的公告，创下其历史最高纪录 [ 14 ] 。 通过对这些公告抽样，我们估计大约一半缺少可利用性证明。 开发者在阅读此类公告时，只能看到某个缺陷被报告了，却无法判断该缺陷在自己的部署环境中是否可被利用。

paragraphs.en: There are two main challenges in producing the missing proof. First, it is difficult to distinguish an exploitable vulnerability from a candidate finding. An untrusted source is transformed several times before it reaches the vulnerable sink, and an exploit requires reasoning through the entire chain. The second is the verification challenge. Even after constructing a candidate exploit, it can be difficult to determine whether the vulnerability was actually triggered. In particular, relying on a model to judge its own exploit can result in incorrect claims of success without evidence from the application’s execution.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成缺失的证明方面存在两个主要挑战。 首先，很难区分可利用的漏洞与候选发现。 不可信的来源在到达漏洞汇聚点之前会经历多次转换，而利用漏洞需要对整条链路进行推理。 其次是验证方面的挑战。 即使构造了候选利用，也可能难以确定漏洞是否真的被触发。 特别是，依赖模型自行判断其利用是否成功，可能会在没有应用执行证据的情况下做出错误的成功断言。

paragraphs.en: A working PoE addresses both challenges by demonstrating the security impact of a reported finding. Rather than relying on the hypotheses from a vulnerability report or the model’s own assessment, a PoE demonstrates that the vulnerable path can be reached and that the intended exploit succeeds under the application’s execution conditions. Based on this premise, we present Ulysses , our automated PoE generation harness.

paragraphs.en: Billions of web applications are served online. Almost every internet user interacts with an application on the web. Web applications expose functionality over HTTP requests and accept input via request parameters, headers, and bodies. In source code, an externally controlled input enters the application at a source and propagates through program logic before reaching a potentially security-sensitive operation, or sink . A vulnerability arises when an untrusted input can reach a sensitive operation without adequate validation. This lets an attacker read or modify data, bypass authentication, or, at worst, execute arbitrary code. MITRE standardizes these flaws by describing the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) as a taxonomy of the types of underlying weaknesses. It publishes the Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) list, which assigns an identifier to each vulnerability. A new vulnerability found is called a zero-day (Day 0), while once it is publicly disclosed, it is called an N-day (Day N) vulnerability.

sents.en: A vulnerability arises when an untrusted input can reach a sensitive operation without adequate validation.
sents.zh: 当不可信的输入能够在未经充分验证的情况下到达敏感操作时，就产生了漏洞。

sents.en: This lets an attacker read or modify data, bypass authentication, or, at worst, execute arbitrary code.
sents.zh: 这使攻击者能够读取或修改数据、绕过身份验证，最坏的情况下还能执行任意代码。

sents.en: MITRE standardizes these flaws by describing the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) as a taxonomy of the types of underlying weaknesses.
sents.zh: MITRE通过将通用缺陷列表（CWE）描述为底层缺陷类型的分类体系，对这些缺陷进行了标准化。

sents.en: It publishes the Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) list, which assigns an identifier to each vulnerability.
sents.zh: 它发布了通用漏洞与暴露（CVE）列表，为每个漏洞分配一个标识符。

sents.en: A new vulnerability found is called a zero-day (Day 0), while once it is publicly disclosed, it is called an N-day (Day N) vulnerability.
sents.zh: 新发现的漏洞被称为零日漏洞（Day 0），而一旦被公开披露，就被称为N日漏洞（Day N）。

paragraphs.en: Separately from this disclosure status, we describe three conditions based on how much an agent knows about a target vulnerability. In the advisory-informed condition, the agent receives the public facts an advisory carries, the weakness class, the affected component, and the intended effect, but no mechanism, payload, or proof. In the zero-knowledge condition, the agent does not receive an advisory and must locate and exploit the flaw from the source code and the running endpoint. In the static-analysis-seeded condition, the agent additionally receives the findings of a static analyzer over the source, which may or may not localize the vulnerability. All conditions target disclosed (N-day) vulnerabilities and differ only in what the agent is told. Zero-knowledge here refers only to the attacker’s lack of prior information about the target.
paragraphs.zh: 与此披露状态分开，我们根据智能体对目标漏洞的了解程度描述三种条件。 在公告知情条件下，智能体获得公告所携带的公开事实、缺陷类别、受影响组件以及预期效果，但不获得机制、载荷或证明。 在零知识条件下，智能体不获得公告，必须从源代码和运行中的端点来定位并利用该缺陷。 在静态分析种子条件下，智能体额外获得静态分析器对源代码的发现结果，这些结果可能定位也可能未定位到该漏洞。 所有条件均针对已披露（N-day）漏洞，且仅在告知智能体的内容上有所不同。 这里的零知识仅指攻击者对目标缺乏先验信息。

paragraphs.en: Many web vulnerabilities, when exploited, create an observable effect that can be validated. Injection flaws can run an attacker’s command, read or modify database records, or send data to an external host. Broken access control can expose files or records of other users. Authentication and authorization failures can grant a session the attacker should not have, or even admin access. Path traversal can read protected files or write new ones. Ulysses targets eight of such vulnerabilities: unauthorized file read, file creation, unauthorized db read, db modification, data exfiltration, remote code execution, privilege escalation, and authentication bypass. Each can be observed directly on the running system, such as a file being read, a database record returned, or a connection made back to the attacker.
paragraphs.zh: 许多 Web 漏洞在被利用时会产生可观察到的效果，从而可以加以验证。 注入缺陷可以运行攻击者的命令、读取或修改数据库记录，或者向外部主机发送数据。 访问控制失效可能暴露其他用户的文件或记录。 身份验证与授权失败可能授予攻击者本不应拥有的会话，甚至管理员权限。 路径遍历可以读取受保护的文件或写入新文件。 Ulysses 针对八种此类漏洞：未授权文件读取、文件创建、未授权数据库读取、数据库修改、数据外泄、远程代码执行、权限提升以及身份验证绕过。 每一种都可以在运行中的系统上被直接观察到，例如某个文件被读取、某条数据库记录被返回，或者向攻击者发起了反向连接。

paragraphs.en: Real-world application vulnerabilities are more complex. Applications often span multiple files, making it harder to locate a vulnerable data flow. Identifying a possible source and sink is only a starting point. An exploit must be constructed by reasoning through the intermediate transformations needed to carry attacker-controlled input to the sink and trigger the intended behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 真实世界中的应用程序漏洞更加复杂。 应用程序通常跨越多个文件，这使得定位存在漏洞的数据流变得更加困难。 识别出一个可能的源和汇只是一个起点。 还必须通过推理中间所需的转换过程来构造漏洞利用，以便将攻击者可控的输入传递到汇并触发预期行为。

paragraphs.en: Naturally, when exploiting, a security expert would like to determine whether the exploit achieved its intended effect. However, the appropriate way to verify success depends on the type of exploit. For example, after gaining Remote Code Execution (RCE) access, an expert can verify the result by opening a shell or forwarding a command to the target. Similarly, for a file read vulnerability, successful exploitation can be verified by reading secret data from the target. This notion of using observable evidence to verify task completion is closely related to Capture-The-Flag (CTF) style tasks [ 33 ] , where LLM agents operate in black-box environments and use hidden flags as evidence to show task completion. Ulysses introduces planted, observable effects that serve as evidence of successful exploitation to produce the proof of exploits.
paragraphs.zh: 自然地，安全专家在利用漏洞时，希望确定该利用是否达到了预期效果。 然而，验证成功的合适方式取决于利用的类型。 例如，在获得远程代码执行（RCE）权限后，专家可以通过打开一个 shell 或向目标转发一条命令来验证结果。 类似地，对于文件读取漏洞，可以通过从目标读取机密数据来验证利用是否成功。 这种使用可观察的证据来验证任务完成的概念与夺旗赛（CTF）风格的任务 [ 33 ] 密切相关，在这类任务中，LLM 智能体在黑盒环境中运行，并使用隐藏的 flag 作为证明任务完成的证据。 Ulysses 引入了预先植入的、可观察的效果，作为成功利用的证据，从而生成漏洞利用的证明。

paragraphs.en: The design of Ulysses is guided by four challenges in PoE generation. First, vulnerability discovery and exploit verification are different tasks, since finding potentially vulnerable code does not establish that the finding is exploitable. Secondly, a finding may also have multiple possible exploit paths, making it necessary to explore different hypotheses rather than following a single path. Third, complex vulnerabilities require chaining multiple exploit steps. This requires the system to plan and adapt from previous attempts. Finally, an exploiting agent cannot reliably verify its own success. In the following sections, we describe these challenges and the corresponding mechanisms used by Ulysses .
paragraphs.zh: Ulysses 的设计由 PoE 生成中的四项挑战所指导。 首先，漏洞发现与漏洞利用验证是不同的任务，因为找到潜在易受攻击的代码并不能证明该发现是可利用的。 其次，一个发现可能存在多条可能的利用路径，因此有必要探索不同的假设，而不是遵循单一路径。 第三，复杂的漏洞需要串联多个利用步骤。 这要求系统能够根据先前的尝试进行规划和调整。 最后，利用型智能体无法可靠地验证自身的成功。 在接下来的章节中，我们将描述这些挑战以及 Ulysses 所采用的相应机制。

paragraphs.en: Vulnerability detection involves the use of tools for initial surfacing and multi-step analysis. These could be rule-based static analyzers such as Semgrep, CodeQL, or Bandit [ 31 , 13 , 29 ] , an LLM-assisted scanner such as Absentia [ 10 ] or IRIS [ 22 ] , or even a bare CVE description with no candidate location at all. These tools specialize in the detection and marking of sources and sinks, and providing attack plans or information about possible vulnerable locations. Ulysses relies on the use of the above information as a starting point for exploits. Separation of detection from exploitation allows Ulysses to focus on verifying the findings to report real exploitable vulnerabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 漏洞检测涉及使用工具进行初步挖掘和多步分析。 这些工具可以是基于规则的静态分析器，例如 Semgrep、CodeQL 或 Bandit [ 31 , 13 , 29 ]，也可以是 LLM 辅助的扫描器，例如 Absentia [ 10 ] 或 IRIS [ 22 ]，甚至可以是一个没有任何候选位置的纯 CVE 描述。 这些工具专长于检测和标记源点与汇点，并提供攻击计划或有关可能漏洞位置的信息。 Ulysses 依赖将上述信息作为漏洞利用的起点。 将检测与利用分离，使 Ulysses 能够专注于验证发现结果，以报告真实可利用的漏洞。

paragraphs.en: The Planning Agent proposes candidate exploits as a hypothesis graph, where each node is a candidate exploit, and each edge carries the context and reasoning needed to reach the sink. Ulysses chose graph-based execution over a single linear agent loop for three reasons. The first is that an application’s attack surface rarely reduces to one path. Several candidate exploits are usually worth pursuing at once, and a single agent reasoning about all of them serially would need to hold their combined context. The second is that exploitation is not one-shot. A hypothesis that fails in one round may become viable once a later round discovers a different entry point, so the graph is rebuilt each round from the accumulated findings and the previous round’s reflection. This lets later rounds pursue paths that earlier rounds missed. Finally, graph-based execution keeps context passing efficient. Each node receives only the context carried by the edges leading into it, rather than the full history of everything attempted so far. Finally, using hypothesis graphs Ulysses avoids the periodic compaction that a single long-running agent loop would otherwise need to remain within its context window. [ 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 规划智能体（Planning Agent）将候选利用方案作为假设图提出，其中每个节点是一个候选利用方案，每条边承载到达汇聚点所需的上下文与推理。 Ulysses 选择基于图的执行而非单一的线性智能体循环，理由有三。 第一，一个应用的攻击面很少能归结为一条路径。 通常有多个候选利用方案值得同时推进，而单个智能体串行推理所有方案将不得不持有它们叠加在一起的上下文。 第二，利用并非一次成功。 某个假设在一轮中失败后，可能因后续轮次发现了不同的入口点而变得可行，因此每一轮都会根据累积的发现和上一轮的反思重建该图。 这使得后续轮次能够 pursue 早期轮次遗漏的路径。 最后，基于图的执行使上下文传递保持高效。 每个节点只接收由指向它的边所携带的上下文，而不是迄今为止所有尝试的完整历史。 最后，借助假设图，Ulysses 避免了单一长期运行的智能体循环为保持在上下文窗口内而原本需要的周期性压缩。[ 18 ]

sents.zh: 第一，一个应用的攻击面很少能归结为一条路径。

paragraphs.en: The effect oracle acts as an independent proxy for the real application, checking whether an attempted exploit actually succeeded. The agent has no direct access to the target’s database, file system, or operating system, so it cannot confirm success the way an attacker with real access could. The oracle can, because it alone holds the ground truth it planted, such as a seeded file, an in-scope database value, or a signing key, and reports back only whether the submitted evidence matches that ground truth, without revealing the value itself.
paragraphs.zh: 效果预言机充当真实应用的独立代理，检查一次尝试的利用是否真正成功。 智能体无法直接访问目标的数据库、文件系统或操作系统，因此无法像拥有真实访问权限的攻击者那样确认成功。 预言机可以做到，因为只有它持有其预先埋设的真实依据（ground truth），例如一个植入的文件、一个范围内的数据库值或一个签名密钥，并且只报告提交的证据是否与该真实依据匹配，而不泄露该值本身。

paragraphs.en: A submission might fail because a token’s subject claim is wrong for an authentication bypass or because the submitted content does not match the seeded file for a file read. The oracle responses help the agent refine its next attempt rather than repeat the same mistake. Table 1 lists the eight types of effects that Ulysses verifies, the evidence that a candidate must exploit, and what the oracle checks against. The oracle is hardened and cannot be satisfied by guessing values or brute-force attempts. We harden it by placing randomly generated flags in the oracle check mechanism described in Table 1 . The seeded flags need to be discovered by exploiting the application. The effect oracle verifies whether the flags match. The proof of exploit is generated by Ulysses only when the effect oracle confirms the correct flag submission.

paragraphs.en: Ulysses runs on two separate hosts interconnected by a virtual network. The agent runs on Host A inside a Docker sandbox. The target application, the effect oracle, and the effect listeners run on Host B. The target is served as an HTTP Web server running as a Docker container. The Effect oracle has two listeners, one for RCE and the other for data exfiltration. The security group controls what ports can be reached on Host A and Host B. We allow the agent to reach the target and the effect oracle. To prevent false submissions, the agent is denied access to listener ports. Only Host B can reach its own listeners. This ensures that a reverse shell or a beacon on a listener can come only from the target.

paragraphs.en: Ulysses runs a loop of planning, exploitation, and reflection on the hypothesis graph. The loop runs for several rounds until a time budget or a round limit is reached. The figure 3 describes our overall flow.
paragraphs.zh: Ulysses 在假设图上运行一个由规划、利用和反思组成的循环。 该循环运行若干轮，直到达到时间预算或轮数上限。 图 3 描述了我们的整体流程。

sents.zh: Ulysses 在假设图上运行一个由规划、利用和反思组成的循环。

sents.en: The loop runs for several rounds until a time budget or a round limit is reached.
sents.zh: 该循环运行若干轮，直到达到时间预算或轮数上限。

sents.en: The figure 3 describes our overall flow.
sents.zh: 图 3 描述了我们的整体流程。

paragraphs.en: The agent runs as an attacker. It has white-box access to the source code and reaches the hosted target over the network. It has no direct access to the target’s database, file system, or operating system. The oracle is an independent arbitrator. It knows only the ground truth it planted, such as the names of seeded files, in-scope database values, or the runtime signing key, and it does not know which findings are exploitable. The agent and the target run on separate hosts, and the agent cannot reach the oracle’s effect listeners, so it cannot fabricate a callback when submitting a proof. Since the agent never sees the planted seeds, it cannot forge evidence of exploits.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体以攻击者的身份运行。 它对源代码拥有白盒访问权限，并通过网络访问托管的攻击目标。 它无法直接访问目标的数据库、文件系统或操作系统。 预言机是一个独立的仲裁者。 它只知道事先植入的真实信息，例如植入文件的名称、范围内的数据库值或运行时签名密钥，而不知道哪些发现是可利用的。 智能体和目标运行在不同的主机上，智能体无法访问预言机的效果监听器，因此它无法在提交证明时伪造回调。 由于智能体从未看到植入的种子，它无法伪造利用的证据。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 describes the loop. The Planning Agent proposes hypotheses. Ulysses tests every hypothesis in parallel and marks one as exploitable when the oracle validates it. The Reflection Agent then summarizes the round and seeds the next planner. Every agent has a turn limit to avoid stalling. The loop returns the refined report and the effect-verified PoEs.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 描述了该循环。 规划智能体提出假设。 Ulysses 并行测试每个假设，并在预言机验证通过时将其中一个标记为可利用。 随后，反思智能体总结本轮内容并为下一轮规划器提供种子。 每个智能体都有轮次上限，以避免停滞。 该循环返回精炼后的报告以及经过效果验证的 PoE。

sents.zh: 算法 1 描述了该循环。

sents.en: The Planning Agent proposes hypotheses.
sents.zh: 规划智能体提出假设。

paragraphs.en: The Planning Agent reads the vulnerability scanner’s attack plan and chains, the source, and the previous round’s reflection. The planner is a broader analyzer and is more concerned with finding all possible scenarios that can lead to hypotheses. These include chaining attack chains or exploiting even low-probability ones. We test hypotheses in batches in order of decreasing confidence, as assigned by the planner. Each round, the planner tries to generate unique hypotheses. The reflection of the previous round guides it to generate plans that are more likely to succeed than the previous ones.
paragraphs.zh: 规划智能体读取漏洞扫描器的攻击计划与攻击链、数据源以及上一轮的反思内容。 规划器是一个更广泛的分析器，更关注找出所有可能引出假设的场景。 这包括串联攻击链，或利用即使是低概率的攻击链。 我们按照规划器分配的置信度递减顺序分批测试假设。 每一轮，规划器都会尝试生成唯一的假设。 上一轮的反思引导它生成比之前的计划更有可能成功的计划。

paragraphs.en: The Exploit Node creates a subagent for every hypothesis node. The exploiter node uses Python scripts or bash commands to test every hypothesis and trigger HTTP Requests against the target app. It also calls for the proof submitter to verify and submit proof of exploit to the effect oracle. The agent never judges the exploit by itself; instead, it triggers the payload and lets the oracle decide. Once an exploit is validated by the effect oracle, the outputs are passed to the Proof of Exploit Generation Node. At the end of exploitation, a hypothesis is either exploitable, vulnerable but non-exploitable, or benign. We filter out vulnerable and benign reports and keep only confirmed exploits.
paragraphs.zh: Exploit 节点为每个假设节点创建一个子智能体。 exploit 节点使用 Python 脚本或 bash 命令来测试每个假设，并对目标应用触发 HTTP 请求。 它还会调用 proof submitter 来验证并向 effect oracle 提交漏洞利用证明。 智能体从不自行判断漏洞利用是否成功；相反，它会触发 payload 并让 oracle 来做出决定。 一旦漏洞利用被 effect oracle 验证通过，输出就会被传递给 Proof of Exploit Generation 节点。 在漏洞利用阶段结束时，一个假设的状态要么是可利用的，要么是存在漏洞但不可利用的，要么是无害的。 我们会过滤掉存在漏洞但不可利用的报告和无害报告，只保留已确认的漏洞利用。

paragraphs.en: For every exploit the oracle verifies, a PoE node generates a Proof of Exploit. The PoE node is a separate agent, attached to the exploit node by an edge. It is a conditional node that fires only when the effect oracle signals exploit success. The PoE is a standalone Python script that reproduces the exploit on the deployed target. To evaluate PoE quality, we re-run them against the deployed targets and verify whether the expected effect is achieved.

paragraphs.en: Ulysses verifies an exploit by observing its effect on a live target. Evaluating it requires a deployed and running web application and the source code at the vulnerable commit. Existing benchmarks target memory-safety bugs, build-only libraries, or synthetic code, and validate success by crash or by label rather than by executing a real exploit against a running web application. We curate WebExploitGym , a benchmark of real web application CVEs, each packaged as a deployable instance with the seeded state needed to observe a successful exploit.

paragraphs.en: WebExploitGym is built from vulnerabilities disclosed through the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) [ 23 ] and GitHub Security Advisories (GHSA) [ 12 ] . Each data point ships with a deployable version of the affected application at its vulnerable release, together with the seeded values intended to observe the effect. It receives only the CVE identifier, a summary, and any credentials that the attacker needs. Submissions are scored by executing the agent’s PoE against the deployed instance and confirming the intended effect. All CVEs are disclosed after the training cutoff of the models we evaluate. WebExploitGym comprises 25 vulnerability instances across five programming languages and a diverse set of CWE weakness classes.

paragraphs.en: : How effective is Ulysses in converting detected vulnerabilities into PoEs ?
paragraphs.zh: ： Ulysses 在将检测到的漏洞转化为 PoE 方面的效果如何？

paragraphs.en: Converting candidate findings into reliable Proof of Exploitation (PoE) has two challenges. First, static analyzers are noisy. In Figure 4 , we analyze the injection and exploitable categories of OWASP BenchmarkPython (CWE 22/78/89/94/502/611); CodeQL flags candidates with 48% precision and Absentia flags with 54% precision. Roughly half of every flagged candidate is a false positive. Second, the agent’s ability to self-judge exploits is weak. Pooled across both seed detectors and all three backbone models, precision falls to 0.422 for the full multi-hypothesis graph and to 0.193 for a simple single-loop ReAct agent using identical tools, against 1.000 by construction for the effect oracle pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 将候选发现转化为可靠的利用证明（PoE）面临两个挑战。 首先，静态分析器噪声很大。 在图 4 中，我们分析了 OWASP BenchmarkPython（CWE 22/78/89/94/502/611）的注入和可利用类别；CodeQL 以 48% 的精确率标记候选，而 Absentia 的精确率为 54%。 每个被标记的候选中大约一半是误报。 其次，智能体自我判断利用是否成立的能力较弱。 将所有种子检测器和三个骨干模型的数据合并来看，完整的多假设图的精确率降至 0.422，使用相同工具的简单单循环 ReAct 智能体的精确率降至 0.193，而效果预言机流水线按构造精确率为 1.000。

sents.zh: 每个被标记的候选中大约一半是误报。

sents.zh: 其次，智能体自我判断利用是否成立的能力较弱。

paragraphs.en: Sophisticated agents fail less because they explore more hypotheses to test before deciding to report. Agents that reason about the exploit are the least reliable judges of whether the exploit actually worked. This is because of high faith in their evidence and reasoning process, while the effect is unobservable. Ulysses fixes self-reporting issues by using the effect oracle to observe the exploit. Therefore, it never emits Proof of Exploit from an agent’s self-report. It synthesizes only when the effect oracle has confirmed.
paragraphs.zh: 精密的智能体之所以失败较少，是因为它们在决定上报之前会探索更多待验证的假设。 对漏洞利用进行推理的智能体，恰恰是判断该漏洞利用是否真正生效的最不可靠的裁判。 这是因为它们对自身证据和推理过程抱有高度信心，而实际效果却不可观测。 Ulysses 通过使用效果预言机来观测漏洞利用，从而修复了自我上报的问题。 因此，它绝不会根据智能体的自我上报而发出漏洞利用证明（Proof of Exploit）。 只有在效果预言机确认之后，它才会进行综合判定。

sents.zh: 精密的智能体之所以失败较少，是因为它们在决定上报之前会探索更多待验证的假设。

sents.zh: 这是因为它们对自身证据和推理过程抱有高度信心，而实际效果却不可观测。

sents.en: Ulysses fixes self-reporting issues by using the effect oracle to observe the exploit.
sents.zh: Ulysses 通过使用效果预言机来观测漏洞利用，从而修复了自我上报的问题。

sents.en: Therefore, it never emits Proof of Exploit from an agent’s self-report.
sents.zh: 因此，它绝不会根据智能体的自我上报而发出漏洞利用证明（Proof of Exploit）。

sents.en: It synthesizes only when the effect oracle has confirmed.
sents.zh: 只有在效果预言机确认之后，它才会进行综合判定。

paragraphs.en: : Does Ulysses exploit complex vulnerabilities in real-world web applications?
paragraphs.zh: : Ulysses 是否会利用真实世界 Web 应用中的复杂漏洞？

paragraphs.en: We evaluated Ulysses on WebExploitGym , a corpus of real CVEs from web applications disclosed after the model training cutoff. Each target is deployed from its original source, with its public proof-of-concept withheld from the agent. The effect oracle confirms the exploit during the run, and we re-execute the generated PoE against the deployed target to confirm it reproduces. We report the conversion rate of the scaffolded targets on which Ulysses produces an effect-verified exploit. We run the three information conditions defined in Section 2 , advisory-informed, Semgrep seeded, and zero-knowledge, holding the model and the target fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 WebExploitGym 上评估 Ulysses，这是一个包含在模型训练截止日期之后披露的来自 Web 应用的真实 CVE 的语料库。 每个目标均从其原始源代码部署，且其公开的概念验证（proof-of-concept）不会提供给智能体。 效果预言机（effect oracle）会在运行过程中确认漏洞利用是否成功，我们还会对生成的 PoE 针对已部署的目标重新执行，以确认其可复现。 我们报告 Ulysses 生成经效果验证的漏洞利用的脚手架目标的转化率。 我们在第 2 节定义的三种信息条件下运行实验，即建议引导（advisory-informed）、Semgrep 种子化和零知识（zero-knowledge），同时保持模型和目标不变。

sents.en: We evaluated Ulysses on WebExploitGym , a corpus of real CVEs from web applications disclosed after the model training cutoff.
sents.zh: 我们在 WebExploitGym 上评估 Ulysses，这是一个包含在模型训练截止日期之后披露的来自 Web 应用的真实 CVE 的语料库。

sents.en: Each target is deployed from its original source, with its public proof-of-concept withheld from the agent.
sents.zh: 每个目标均从其原始源代码部署，且其公开的概念验证（proof-of-concept）不会提供给智能体。

sents.en: The effect oracle confirms the exploit during the run, and we re-execute the generated PoE against the deployed target to confirm it reproduces.
sents.zh: 效果预言机（effect oracle）会在运行过程中确认漏洞利用是否成功，我们还会对生成的 PoE 针对已部署的目标重新执行，以确认其可复现。

sents.en: We report the conversion rate of the scaffolded targets on which Ulysses produces an effect-verified exploit.
sents.zh: 我们报告 Ulysses 生成经效果验证的漏洞利用的脚手架目标的转化率。

sents.en: We run the three information conditions defined in Section 2 , advisory-informed, Semgrep seeded, and zero-knowledge, holding the model and the target fixed.
sents.zh: 我们在第 2 节定义的三种信息条件下运行实验，即建议引导（advisory-informed）、Semgrep 种子化和零知识（zero-knowledge），同时保持模型和目标不变。

paragraphs.en: Ulysses produces effect-verified PoEs for 10 of 25 targets under the informed advisory condition, compared to 4 of 25 under zero knowledge. Semgrep-seeded analysis identifies 3 targets, but the agent must still triage noisy findings to determine reachability, resulting in fewer successful conversions than when the advisory directly identifies the affected component.
paragraphs.zh: 在有情报提示的咨询条件下，Ulysses 为 25 个目标中的 10 个生成了经过效果验证的 PoE，而在零知识条件下仅为 25 个中的 4 个。 基于 Semgrep 种子的分析识别出 3 个目标，但智能体仍需对含噪声的发现进行分诊以确定可达性，导致成功转化的数量少于由咨询直接指出受影响组件的情况。

paragraphs.en: We use an instance from WebExploitGym to illustrate a Proof of Exploit (PoE) using Ulysses . We consider CVE-2026-77914 in rConfig [ 30 ] , an application built on Laravel. The vulnerability is an authenticated path traversal in the export-download endpoint. The advisory (GHSA-m5rw-jcrm-mmwc) describes the vulnerability and affected component, but does not provide a PoE, reproduction steps, or a payload.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 WebExploitGym 中的一个实例来说明利用 Ulysses 进行利用证明（PoE）的过程。 我们考虑 rConfig [ 30 ] 中的 CVE-2026-77914，该应用基于 Laravel 构建。 该漏洞是 export-download 端点中的一个经过身份验证的路径遍历漏洞。 该公告（GHSA-m5rw-jcrm-mmwc）描述了漏洞及受影响的组件，但没有提供利用证明（PoE）、复现步骤或载荷。

sents.en: We use an instance from WebExploitGym to illustrate a Proof of Exploit (PoE) using Ulysses .
sents.zh: 我们使用 WebExploitGym 中的一个实例来说明利用 Ulysses 进行利用证明（PoE）的过程。

sents.en: We consider CVE-2026-77914 in rConfig [ 30 ] , an application built on Laravel.
sents.zh: 我们考虑 rConfig [ 30 ] 中的 CVE-2026-77914，该应用基于 Laravel 构建。

sents.en: The vulnerability is an authenticated path traversal in the export-download endpoint.
sents.zh: 该漏洞是 export-download 端点中的一个经过身份验证的路径遍历漏洞。

sents.en: The advisory (GHSA-m5rw-jcrm-mmwc) describes the vulnerability and affected component, but does not provide a PoE, reproduction steps, or a payload.
sents.zh: 该公告（GHSA-m5rw-jcrm-mmwc）描述了漏洞及受影响的组件，但没有提供利用证明（PoE）、复现步骤或载荷。

paragraphs.en: The exploit requires multiple steps to work together. The agent must first authenticate through a CSRF-protected login flow and then identify the correct download endpoint and parameter, filename . The surrounding code also contains a PathContainmentService that protects other controllers. This makes it easy to incorrectly assume that the vulnerable endpoint is similarly protected.
paragraphs.zh: 该漏洞利用需要多个步骤配合才能成功。 智能体必须先通过受 CSRF 保护的登录流程完成身份验证，然后识别出正确的下载端点及其参数 filename。 周边的代码中还包含一个保护其他控制器的 PathContainmentService。 这容易让人错误地认为存在漏洞的端点也受到了类似的保护。

sents.en: The exploit requires multiple steps to work together.
sents.zh: 该漏洞利用需要多个步骤配合才能成功。

sents.en: The agent must first authenticate through a CSRF-protected login flow and then identify the correct download endpoint and parameter, filename .
sents.zh: 智能体必须先通过受 CSRF 保护的登录流程完成身份验证，然后识别出正确的下载端点及其参数 filename。

sents.en: The surrounding code also contains a PathContainmentService that protects other controllers.
sents.zh: 周边的代码中还包含一个保护其他控制器的 PathContainmentService。

sents.en: This makes it easy to incorrectly assume that the vulnerable endpoint is similarly protected.
sents.zh: 这容易让人错误地认为存在漏洞的端点也受到了类似的保护。

paragraphs.en: In the zero-knowledge condition, Ulysses does not receive any vulnerability-specific information. It must first identify that a vulnerability exists, localize it to the relevant code and endpoint, and then construct and verify the PoE. In this case, the planner eventually identifies the vulnerable source code, but is misled by the PathContainmentService and fails to establish that the vulnerable endpoint is actually reachable. Without a localization signal, the exploit agent spends its budget discovering the vulnerability instead of validating and exploiting it.
paragraphs.zh: 在零知识条件下，Ulysses 不会收到任何针对漏洞的具体信息。 它必须首先识别出漏洞的存在，将漏洞定位到相关代码和端点，然后构造并验证 PoE。 在这种情况下，规划器最终识别出了存在漏洞的源代码，但被 PathContainmentService 误导，未能确认该漏洞端点实际上是可到达的。 缺乏定位信号时，智能体会把预算耗在发现漏洞上，而不是验证和利用漏洞。

sents.en: In the zero-knowledge condition, Ulysses does not receive any vulnerability-specific information.
sents.zh: 在零知识条件下，Ulysses 不会收到任何针对漏洞的具体信息。

sents.zh: 它必须首先识别出漏洞的存在，将漏洞定位到相关代码和端点，然后构造并验证 PoE。

sents.zh: 在这种情况下，规划器最终识别出了存在漏洞的源代码，但被 PathContainmentService 误导，未能确认该漏洞端点实际上是可到达的。

sents.zh: 缺乏定位信号时，智能体会把预算耗在发现漏洞上，而不是验证和利用漏洞。

paragraphs.en: Ulysses receives all findings produced by Semgrep. The set contains FileDownloadController.php:24 as a candidate vulnerability, along with several other plausible findings. The agent must evaluate these candidates, determine which ones correspond to reachable vulnerabilities, and attempt to exploit them. For each finding, it still needs to identify the reachable endpoint, authenticate to the application, construct the request, and verify the resulting effect.
paragraphs.zh: Ulysses 接收 Semgrep 产生的所有发现结果。 结果集中包含 FileDownloadController.php:24 作为一个候选漏洞，以及其他若干疑似发现。 智能体必须评估这些候选结果，判断哪些对应于可达的漏洞，并尝试利用它们。 对于每个发现，它仍然需要识别可达的端点、向应用程序认证、构造请求，并验证所产生的效果。

sents.en: Ulysses receives all findings produced by Semgrep.
sents.zh: Ulysses 接收 Semgrep 产生的所有发现结果。

sents.en: The set contains FileDownloadController.php:24 as a candidate vulnerability, along with several other plausible findings.
sents.zh: 结果集中包含 FileDownloadController.php:24 作为一个候选漏洞，以及其他若干疑似发现。

sents.zh: 智能体必须评估这些候选结果，判断哪些对应于可达的漏洞，并尝试利用它们。

sents.en: For each finding, it still needs to identify the reachable endpoint, authenticate to the application, construct the request, and verify the resulting effect.
sents.zh: 对于每个发现，它仍然需要识别可达的端点、向应用程序认证、构造请求，并验证所产生的效果。

paragraphs.en: Static analysis helps to resolve the localization barrier, allowing Ulysses to efficiently test multiple hypotheses. This helps the agent turn potential findings into verified PoEs. In this case, Ulysses successfully produces a PoE for the target vulnerability using the Semgrep findings. This also demonstrates how Ulysses can be used to analyze and validate the findings reported by static-analysis tools.
paragraphs.zh: 静态分析有助于消除定位障碍，使 Ulysses 能够高效地测试多个假设。 这有助于智能体将潜在的发现转化为经验证的 PoE。 在这种情况下，Ulysses 利用 Semgrep 的发现成功地为目标漏洞生成了 PoE。 这也展示了如何使用 Ulysses 来分析和验证静态分析工具报告的发现。

sents.en: Static analysis helps to resolve the localization barrier, allowing Ulysses to efficiently test multiple hypotheses.
sents.zh: 静态分析有助于消除定位障碍，使 Ulysses 能够高效地测试多个假设。

sents.en: This helps the agent turn potential findings into verified PoEs.
sents.zh: 这有助于智能体将潜在的发现转化为经验证的 PoE。

sents.en: In this case, Ulysses successfully produces a PoE for the target vulnerability using the Semgrep findings.
sents.zh: 在这种情况下，Ulysses 利用 Semgrep 的发现成功地为目标漏洞生成了 PoE。

sents.en: This also demonstrates how Ulysses can be used to analyze and validate the findings reported by static-analysis tools.
sents.zh: 这也展示了如何使用 Ulysses 来分析和验证静态分析工具报告的发现。

paragraphs.en: In this case, Ulysses receives more semantic information than in the previous condition. It knows that the target contains a path-traversal vulnerability and is given the vulnerable endpoint, but does not know the exact payload required to trigger it. This provides a head start and reduces the burden of exploring the space of possible testing hypotheses. Ulysses can focus on trying different strategies to determine whether the CVE is reachable and to construct a proof of exploit.
paragraphs.zh: 在这种情况下，Ulysses 接收到的语义信息比前一种条件更多。 它知道目标包含一个路径遍历漏洞，并被给出了存在漏洞的端点，但不知道触发该漏洞所需的具体载荷。 这提供了一个先发优势，并减轻了探索可能测试假设空间的负担。 智能体可以专注于尝试不同的策略，以确定该 CVE 是否可达并构建利用证明。

sents.en: In this case, Ulysses receives more semantic information than in the previous condition.
sents.zh: 在这种情况下，Ulysses 接收到的语义信息比前一种条件更多。

sents.en: It knows that the target contains a path-traversal vulnerability and is given the vulnerable endpoint, but does not know the exact payload required to trigger it.
sents.zh: 它知道目标包含一个路径遍历漏洞，并被给出了存在漏洞的端点，但不知道触发该漏洞所需的具体载荷。

sents.zh: 这提供了一个先发优势，并减轻了探索可能测试假设空间的负担。

paragraphs.en: This case study shows how localization information helps an agent move from a vulnerability hypothesis to a verified PoE. Without prior information, Ulysses must spend its budget discovering and localizing the vulnerability. The findings of the Static-analysis provide a precise starting point, while the advisory information provides a higher-level description of what to investigate and where to investigate. In both informed settings, Ulysses uses this information to construct and verify an exploit rather than simply restating the reported vulnerability.
paragraphs.zh: 本案例研究展示了本地化信息如何帮助智能体从漏洞假设走向经过验证的 PoE。 在没有先验信息的情况下，Ulysses 必须消耗预算来发现并定位漏洞。 静态分析的发现提供了一个精确的起点，而通告信息则从更高层面描述了应调查什么以及在哪里调查。 在两种有信息输入的设置中，Ulysses 都利用这些信息来构建并验证漏洞利用，而不是简单地复述所报告的漏洞。

sents.zh: 本案例研究展示了本地化信息如何帮助智能体从漏洞假设走向经过验证的 PoE。

sents.zh: 在没有先验信息的情况下，Ulysses 必须消耗预算来发现并定位漏洞。

sents.zh: 在两种有信息输入的设置中，Ulysses 都利用这些信息来构建并验证漏洞利用，而不是简单地复述所报告的漏洞。

paragraphs.en: For maintainers, the main benefit of a verified PoE is that it reduces the effort required to determine whether a reported vulnerability is real. A vulnerability report may identify a vulnerable component or code pattern, but reproducing the issue can require finding the right endpoint, constructing requests, handling authentication, and determining what observable behavior constitutes successful exploitation. A PoE packages these steps into a concrete, reproducible test.
paragraphs.zh: 对于维护者而言，经验证的 PoE 的主要好处是它减少了判断所报告漏洞是否真实所需的工作量。 漏洞报告可能会指出存在漏洞的组件或代码模式，但复现该问题可能需要找到正确的端点、构造请求、处理身份验证，并确定什么样的可观察行为才算成功利用。 PoE 将这些步骤打包成一个具体、可复现的测试。

sents.en: For maintainers, the main benefit of a verified PoE is that it reduces the effort required to determine whether a reported vulnerability is real.
sents.zh: 对于维护者而言，经验证的 PoE 的主要好处是它减少了判断所报告漏洞是否真实所需的工作量。

sents.en: A vulnerability report may identify a vulnerable component or code pattern, but reproducing the issue can require finding the right endpoint, constructing requests, handling authentication, and determining what observable behavior constitutes successful exploitation.
sents.zh: 漏洞报告可能会指出存在漏洞的组件或代码模式，但复现该问题可能需要找到正确的端点、构造请求、处理身份验证，并确定什么样的可观察行为才算成功利用。

sents.en: A PoE packages these steps into a concrete, reproducible test.
sents.zh: PoE 将这些步骤打包成一个具体、可复现的测试。

paragraphs.en: The PoE also makes vulnerability reports easier to communicate and validate between teams. Rather than asking another developer or security engineer to reproduce a described attack from scratch, the maintainer can provide the executable test together with its success condition. Thus, Ulysses transforms a vulnerability finding into a concrete security test that can be reused for triage, patch validation, and regression testing.
paragraphs.zh: 概念验证（PoE）还使漏洞报告在团队之间更易于沟通和验证。 维护者无需让另一位开发人员或安全工程师从头复现所描述的攻击，而是可以提供可执行的测试及其成功条件。 因此，Ulysses 将漏洞发现转化为具体的安全测试，可用于分类处理、补丁验证和回归测试。

sents.en: The PoE also makes vulnerability reports easier to communicate and validate between teams.
sents.zh: 概念验证（PoE）还使漏洞报告在团队之间更易于沟通和验证。

sents.en: Rather than asking another developer or security engineer to reproduce a described attack from scratch, the maintainer can provide the executable test together with its success condition.
sents.zh: 维护者无需让另一位开发人员或安全工程师从头复现所描述的攻击，而是可以提供可执行的测试及其成功条件。

sents.en: Thus, Ulysses transforms a vulnerability finding into a concrete security test that can be reused for triage, patch validation, and regression testing.
sents.zh: 因此，Ulysses 将漏洞发现转化为具体的安全测试，可用于分类处理、补丁验证和回归测试。

paragraphs.en: Generating verified exploits remains challenging. Ulysses is currently limited to vulnerabilities that produce an observable server-side effect, and to Day-N vulnerabilities for which a report already exists.
paragraphs.zh: 生成经验证的漏洞利用程序仍然具有挑战性。 Ulysses 目前仅限于会产生可观察的服务器端效应的漏洞，以及已有报告的 Day-N 漏洞。

sents.en: Generating verified exploits remains challenging.
sents.zh: 生成经验证的漏洞利用程序仍然具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: Future iterations could extend the oracle to further effect classes, such as memory-safety bugs validated through crash or sanitizer oracles. Our zero-knowledge condition withholds the advisory from the agent, but still targets a disclosed vulnerability. Whether effect verification can support the discovery of previously undisclosed vulnerabilities remains an open question.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的迭代可以将该 oracle 扩展到更多效果类别，例如通过崩溃或 sanitizer oracle 验证的内存安全漏洞。 我们的零知识条件对智能体隐藏了安全公告，但仍然针对一个已披露的漏洞。 效果验证能否支持发现此前未披露的漏洞，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Our work is subject to several potential limitations that may influence the interpretation and generalization of the results. In the following, we discuss threats across internal, external, construct, and conclusion validity, highlighting the factors that can compromise robustness and suggesting ways to mitigate them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作存在若干潜在局限性，可能影响结果的解释与推广。 下面，我们讨论内部效度、外部效度、建构效度和结论效度方面的威胁，指出可能损害稳健性的因素，并提出缓解这些因素的方法。

paragraphs.en: We consider an exploit successful if we can observe its effect. This observation holds for our eight exploit types. The effect oracle confirms an exploit only after it has observed the effect, so it cannot credit an exploit that did not fire. However, the effect oracle is mechanism blind . The oracle only verifies that the effect occurred through a vulnerability, not through a specific vulnerability under test. A different vulnerability yielding the same observable outcome would pass. We mitigate this in the advisory-informed and static-analysis-seeded conditions with a route-and-vector assertion gate that credits an exploit only when the triggering request matches the target CVE’s endpoint, injection signature, and authentication precondition. In the zero-knowledge case, no such gate is applied because any genuine exploit is a valid discovery.
paragraphs.zh: 如果我们能够观察到漏洞利用的效果，我们就认为它是成功的。 这一观察适用于我们的八种漏洞利用类型。 效果判定器只有在观察到效果之后才会确认一次漏洞利用，因此它不会给未触发的漏洞利用计分。 然而，效果判定器对机制是不可见的。 该判定器只验证效果是通过某个漏洞产生的，而不是通过被测的特定漏洞产生的。 一个产生相同可观察结果的不同漏洞也会通过验证。 在基于安全通告和静态分析种子化的条件下，我们通过路由与向量断言门来缓解这一问题，该门仅在触发请求匹配目标 CVE 的端点、注入特征和认证前置条件时才为漏洞利用计分。 在零知识的情况下，不应用此类门控，因为任何真实的漏洞利用都是有效的发现。

paragraphs.en: Post-cutoff disclosure prevents the model from having memorized the specific CVE advisory or proof of concept. It does not prevent the model from having seen the vulnerable source code in pre-cutoff training data, since many of these applications existed before their CVE was filed. The model may also recall well-known older vulnerabilities and find those instead of the target CVE. The agent runs in a sandbox on a separate host, while the application and the verification oracle are hosted separately. In addition, security groups and rules prevent the agent host from communicating directly with the verification oracle. The agent runs long sessions and has stochastic behavior. For OWASP, we report union pass@3. For WebExploitGym , we evaluate each condition with one run per target, and manually inspect and re-execute every generated PoE. Since each instance provisions a full application, multiple runs varying planner and exploit models are time consuming and expensive.
paragraphs.zh: 截止日期之后的披露可防止模型预先记住特定的 CVE 公告或概念验证。 它无法防止模型在截止日期之前的训练数据中见过存在漏洞的源代码，因为许多应用程序在 CVE 提交之前就已存在。 模型还可能回忆起一些广为人知的较旧漏洞，并找到那些漏洞而不是目标 CVE。 智能体运行在单独主机上的沙箱中，而应用程序和验证预言机则分别托管在其他地方。 此外，安全组和规则阻止智能体主机与验证预言机直接通信。 智能体运行时间长且具有随机性行为。 对于 OWASP，我们报告并集 pass@3。 对于 WebExploitGym，我们对每种条件在每个目标上运行一次进行评估，并手动检查和重新执行每个生成的 PoE。 由于每个实例都要部署一个完整的应用程序，使用不同的规划器和漏洞利用模型进行多次运行既耗时又昂贵。

paragraphs.en: Our testing is limited to web applications and eight effects seen on a running server. We run the web applications via Docker containers and provide code access to the agent sandbox. Vulnerabilities with no such effect, like Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) or Denial of Service (DoS), and memory bugs or non-web apps, are not covered. Although an agent may exploit these bugs through its own discovery or through scanning tools, we cannot observe effects for them.

paragraphs.en: Static analysis tools identify potentially vulnerable code by examining source code or bytecode without running the program. Rule-based systems such as [ 13 ] , [ 31 ] , [ 29 ] , [ 4 ] rely on taint analysis. Code Property graph methods [ 37 ] use unified representations. They use AST, control-flow, and program dependence to track source-to-sink taint flows and vulnerabilities. Although widely used, static analyzers are rarely successful in detecting real-exploitable ones. A comprehensive survey by [ 20 ] finds that most of the tools concentrate on a narrow range of vulnerabilities. Because taint analysis cannot enumerate every program state, static analyzers produce many false positives and miss runtime behavior that diverges from the analyzed code.
paragraphs.zh: 静态分析工具通过在不运行程序的情况下检查源代码或字节码来识别潜在易受攻击的代码。 基于规则的系统，如 [ 13 ]、[ 31 ]、[ 29 ]、[ 4 ]，依赖于污点分析。 代码属性图方法 [ 37 ] 使用统一的表示形式。 它们利用抽象语法树、控制流和程序依赖来追踪从源到汇的污点流和漏洞。 尽管被广泛使用，静态分析器在检测真正可利用的漏洞方面很少成功。 [ 20 ] 的一项全面调查发现，大多数工具只集中于狭窄范围的漏洞。 由于污点分析无法枚举每一个程序状态，静态分析器会产生许多误报，并遗漏与被分析代码不同的运行时行为。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic analysis tools (DAST) identify vulnerabilities by running the source code as a live application. Web application scanners such as OWASP ZAP [ 27 ] and Burp Suite [ 28 ] probe endpoints for injection vulnerabilities. Dynamic analysis creates a Proof of Exploits from successful exploit responses, the same signal on which Ulysses is based. But DAST tools operate blindly to application logic and state, driving handcrafted or rule-based payloads at whatever surface they can reach. This limits them to shallow single-request vulnerabilities and ignores any flaw that requires reasoning through several input transformations before a payload reaches its sink. Ulysses keeps the effect-based confirmation that makes dynamic analysis trustworthy while adding white-box reasoning over the source, letting it construct the multi-step exploits a black-box probe cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 动态分析工具（DAST）通过将源代码作为运行中的应用程序执行来识别漏洞。 诸如 OWASP ZAP [ 27 ] 和 Burp Suite [ 28 ] 之类的 Web 应用程序扫描器会探测端点中的注入漏洞。 动态分析会根据成功的利用响应创建利用证明，这与 Ulysses 所依据的信号相同。 但 DAST 工具对应用程序逻辑和状态一无所知，只是向其能触及的任何表面投放手工构造的或基于规则的载荷。 这使它们只能发现浅层的单请求漏洞，而忽略了任何需要在载荷到达其汇聚点之前对多次输入变换进行推理才能发现的缺陷。 Ulysses 保留了使动态分析值得信赖的基于效果的确认机制，同时增加了对源代码的白盒推理，从而能够构造出黑盒探测无法完成的多步利用。

paragraphs.en: Recently, Large language models have been applied to enhance vulnerable code detection. IRIS [ 22 ] and QLCoder [ 35 ] pair an LLM with static analysis to synthesize better detectors. Combined SAST-and-LLM pipelines report modest recall gains [ 39 ] . IRIS is bound to a fixed set of CodeQL query templates, QLCoder still carries a high false-positive rate even with a strong backbone model [ 2 ] , and none establishes that a reported flaw can actually be exploited. They advance the detection frontier, but leave the verification gap untouched, and Ulysses consumes their output as readily as any static analyzer’s, converting detected candidates into confirmed exploits.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，大语言模型已被应用于增强易受攻击代码的检测。 IRIS [ 22 ] 和 QLCoder [ 35 ] 将大语言模型与静态分析相结合，以合成更好的检测器。 结合SAST与大语言模型的流水线报告了适度的召回率提升 [ 39 ] 。 IRIS 受限于固定的 CodeQL 查询模板集合，QLCoder 即使采用强大的骨干模型仍然存在较高的误报率 [ 2 ] ，而且二者都无法证明所报告的缺陷确实可以被利用。 它们推进了检测的前沿，却未触及验证方面的缺口，而 Ulysses 可以像消费任何静态分析器的输出一样轻松地消费它们的输出，将检测到的候选缺陷转化为已确认的漏洞利用。

paragraphs.en: Several benchmarks assess vulnerability detection and exploitation with language models. Each benchmark focuses on a specific challenge. ExploitBench [ 21 ] targets the V8 JavaScript and WebAssembly engine bugs commonly found in Chrome, Edge, Node.js, and Cloudflare Workers. CyberGym [ 36 ] focuses on memory-safety bugs in C and C++ codebases. It provides 1,507 vulnerability instances sourced from OSS-Fuzz in 188 projects. Agents must generate proof-of-concept tests that trigger crashes to reproduce the bug. CyberGym-E2E [ 34 ] extends this to 920 instances that cover the entire lifecycle: vulnerability discovery, PoC generation, and patch generation. It validates four stages, from crash reproduction through functional correctness of the patch. These benchmarks focus on memory-safety issues (buffer overflows, use-after-free, heap corruption). They validate success through crash reproduction or differential testing against patched versions. Our Benchmark WebExploitGym covers web application vulnerabilities with observable effects for 8 types, thus extending the landscape from libraries and memory safety issues to full running applications.

paragraphs.en: Generating a reliable proof of vulnerability is difficult, as it requires a deep understanding of code flow nested deep through a program. Ulysses shares its central premise that exploitability is best demonstrated by running something rather than asserting it. FaultLine [ 24 ] traces an input from source to sink, explains the branch conditions the input must satisfy, and generates a proof-of-vulnerability test through an iterative feedback loop. PoC Gym [ 11 ] combines static and dynamic information to generate proof-of-concept candidates for CWE-Bench-Java. AnyPoC [ 38 ] is a multi-agent framework that synthesizes and independently re-executes proof-of-concept tests for large systems software such as Firefox, Chromium, and SQLite. These methods generate code-level regression or crash-triggering tests, or, in AntiProof’s case, focus on detector synthesis over general software. Ulysses instead verifies an exploit by its observable effect on a live deployed HTTP service, which requires neither a bug oracle nor a patch.
paragraphs.zh: 生成可靠的漏洞证明十分困难，因为它需要对程序中深层嵌套的代码流有深入的理解。 Ulysses 与其共享同一个核心前提：可利用性最好通过实际运行某段内容来证明，而非仅仅断言。 FaultLine [ 24 ] 追踪输入从源到汇的路径，解释该输入必须满足的分支条件，并通过迭代反馈循环生成漏洞证明测试。 PoC Gym [ 11 ] 结合静态与动态信息，为 CWE-Bench-Java 生成概念验证候选测试。 AnyPoC [ 38 ] 是一个多智能体框架，为 Firefox、Chromium 和 SQLite 等大型系统软件合成并独立重新执行概念验证测试。 这些方法生成代码级的回归测试或触发崩溃的测试，或者像 AntiProof 那样，专注于面向通用软件的检测器合成。 Ulysses 则通过利用对已部署在线 HTTP 服务的可观察影响来验证利用，这既不需要缺陷判定器，也不需要补丁。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous agents have also been applied to offensive security. PentestGPT [ 9 ] drives an LLM through interactive black-box penetration testing, and more recent pentesting agents add structure to the search [ 8 ] . Co-RedTeam [ 19 ] coordinates specialized agents for vulnerability discovery and exploitation and, like Ulysses , grounds its decisions in real execution feedback rather than the model’s assertion alone. Model vendors also ship agentic security review within their own products, such as Codex [ 25 ] and Claude Code [ 1 ] , which binds the reviewer to the model and harness of a single provider. We do not evaluate Claude Code Security or Codex Security because their terms of service do not allow the scanning of third-party repositories. The Ulysses agent loop is open source and runs on any backbone model, consuming the findings of any detector rather than a fixed one, so neither the model nor the vulnerability source is bound to a particular vendor.
paragraphs.zh: 自主智能体也已被应用于攻击性安全领域。 PentestGPT [ 9 ] 通过交互式黑盒渗透测试驱动大语言模型，而较新的渗透测试智能体则为搜索过程增加了结构 [ 8 ] 。 Co-RedTeam [ 19 ] 协调多个专门的智能体进行漏洞发现与利用，并且和 Ulysses 一样，其决策基于真实的执行反馈，而非仅依赖模型自身的断言。 模型厂商也在其自有产品中提供智能体安全审查功能，例如 Codex [ 25 ] 和 Claude Code [ 1 ] ，这将审查者绑定在单一提供商的模型和工具框架上。 我们没有评估 Claude Code Security 或 Codex Security，因为它们的服务条款不允许扫描第三方仓库。 Ulysses 的智能体循环是开源的，可运行于任意骨干模型，并可使用任意检测器的检测结果而非固定某一种，因此无论模型还是漏洞来源都不受特定厂商的约束。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present Ulysses , a specialized security harness to synthesize verifiable web exploits. Using a hypothesis-graph agent alongside an effect-based oracle, Ulysses generates Proofs of Exploits (PoEs) that are confirmed by observed effects rather than by the model’s own judgment. On WebExploitGym , Ulysses produces verified exploits for 10 10 applications and, through coordinated disclosure, reports the first working proof of exploit for 4 4 advisories that were reported.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 Ulysses，一个用于合成可验证网络漏洞利用的安全测试框架（security harness）。 通过使用假设图（hypothesis-graph）智能体与基于效果（effect-based）的判定器，Ulysses 生成的漏洞利用证明（PoEs）由观测到的效果来确认，而非依赖模型自身的判断。 在 WebExploitGym 上，Ulysses 为 10 个应用程序生成了经过验证的漏洞利用，并通过协同披露，首次为 4 个已报告的安全公告提供了可行的漏洞利用证明。

sents.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 Ulysses，一个用于合成可验证网络漏洞利用的安全测试框架（security harness）。

sents.zh: 在 WebExploitGym 上，Ulysses 为 10 个应用程序生成了经过验证的漏洞利用，并通过协同披露，首次为 4 个已报告的安全公告提供了可行的漏洞利用证明。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation shows that vulnerability localization is a critical factor in real-world exploit coverage. Providing the location of the vulnerability more than doubles the number of applications successfully exploited, from 4 4 to 10 10 out of 25 25 . The agent consistently succeeds on exposed, well-localized vulnerabilities, while authenticated and multi-step vulnerabilities remain challenging. These results suggest that progress toward autonomous exploitation will require advances in both vulnerability localization and model capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估表明，漏洞定位是真实世界漏洞利用覆盖率的一个关键因素。 提供漏洞的位置使成功利用的应用数量增加了一倍以上，从 25 个应用中的 4 个增加到 25 个中的 10 个。 该智能体在已暴露且定位明确的漏洞上始终能够成功，而需要身份验证的和多步骤的漏洞仍然具有挑战性。 这些结果表明，实现自主漏洞利用的进展需要在漏洞定位和模型能力两方面都取得进步。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated Ulysses on open-source applications with disclosed vulnerabilities reported through GitHub Security Advisories (GHSA) or the National Vulnerability Database (NVD). These are N-day vulnerabilities, where CVEs are disclosed, but the entire Proof of Exploit is absent. Additionally, we evaluated on the OWASP Benchmark [ 26 ] , which is synthetic by construction and has a known ground truth.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在通过 GitHub 安全公告（GHSA）或国家漏洞数据库（NVD）报告了已披露漏洞的开源应用程序上对 Ulysses 进行了评估。 这些是 N-day 漏洞，即 CVE 已经披露，但完整的漏洞利用证明（Proof of Exploit）缺失。 此外，我们还在 OWASP Benchmark [ 26 ] 上进行了评估，该基准在设计上是合成构造的，并且具有已知的真实标注（ground truth）。

paragraphs.en: For advisories that lacked a Proof of Exploit (PoE), Ulysses generated exploitability proofs. We disclosed every generated exploit to the affected maintainers through coordinated disclosure. Ulysses operates only on already-disclosed vulnerabilities. We used vulnerabilities disclosed after the models’ training cutoff to control for memorization and to evaluate the zero-knowledge condition, in which the agent is given no advisory. Ulysses was not run to attack production systems or find new vulnerabilities. All targets were local deployments of affected applications.
paragraphs.zh: 对于缺少利用证明（PoE）的安全公告，Ulysses 生成了可利用性证明。 我们通过协同披露的方式，将每一个生成的漏洞利用程序都披露给了受影响的维护者。 Ulysses 仅针对已经披露的漏洞进行操作。 我们使用在模型训练截止日期之后披露的漏洞来控制记忆效应，并评估零知识条件，即不为智能体提供任何安全公告。 Ulysses 并未被用于攻击生产系统或发现新的漏洞。 所有目标均为受影响应用程序的本地部署。

paragraphs.en: We acknowledge that the open source red teaming agent could be repurposed to locate vulnerabilities for malicious purposes. Ulysses is intended for research and for the review of code that the user owns or is authorized to audit, and we ask that it be used accordingly. The method was created for safety and defense purposes, and we intend no harm to users.

sents.zh: 本工作是亚马逊 Nova AI 挑战赛的一部分，该挑战赛为参赛的大学团队提供了资金支持和 AWS 计算额度。

sents.en: The study design, model selection, analysis, and the decision to publish were made independently by the authors.
sents.zh: 研究设计、模型选择、分析以及发表的决定均由作者独立作出。

sents.en: We also acknowledge support from national funds through Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia, I.P.
sents.zh: 我们还要感谢葡萄牙科学技术基金会（Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia, I.P.）通过国家资金提供的支持。

sents.en: (FCT), under projects UID/50021/2025 and UID/PRR/50021/2025.
sents.zh: （FCT），资助项目编号为 UID/50021/2025 和 UID/PRR/50021/2025。

sents.en: This work is also co-financed by FCT through the Carnegie Mellon Portugal Program under the fellowship PRT/BD/155049/2024.
sents.zh: 本工作还由 FCT 通过卡内基梅隆葡萄牙项目以奖学金 PRT/BD/155049/2024 共同资助。

sents.en: Li is partly supported by the CMU CyLab seed grant.
sents.zh: Li 部分受到 CMU CyLab 种子基金的支持。
